summary: Iteration 80 — Market Narrative Profiles™ (Phase 1, Cultural Edition™). action_items: (test-only) Re-run frontend Playwright using data-testid='cew-market-usa_miami' / 'cew-market-italy_milano' to fully validate F2–F8 (profile card, prefill, override+reset, market switch milano, review-narrative, POST body, ce-narrative-trace). Backend is 100% green and DOM screenshots confirm narrative wiring is in place.
critical_code_review_comments: cultural_editions.py is now ~575 lines and growing (markets taxonomy, profile router, draft CRUD, LLM composition, prompt builders). Recommend splitting into routers/cultural_editions/{markets.py, drafts.py, generation.py} so the LLM composition layer (build_system_prompt + _generate_market_version) can be unit-tested in isolation.

create_draft() does NOT validate selected_narrative_mode / selected_intensity against the curated enums (hospitality/cinematic/technical/minimal/editorial/balanced/…). A malicious / buggy client could pass arbitrary strings which would then leak into the system prompt as 'Modalità narrativa: <free text>'. Add a Pydantic Literal[...] or whitelist check.

generation_meta.market_influence is True only when the LLM path succeeds; the fallback path returns market_influence absent (treated as False). The frontend ce-narrative-trace will still render thanks to applied_market_biases, but main agent should ensure UI doesn't claim 'Market Influence applied' when meta.fallback=True.

Market button cards (data-testid='cew-market-{code}') correctly expose testids, but the Miami market profile CHIPS rendered in the curated card are 'hospitality luxury / outdoor living / atmosfere luminose' which differ from the narrative_direction chips (HOSPITALITY/CINEMATIC/WARM LUXURY/LIFESTYLE-DRIVEN) shown inside data-testid='cew-narrative-profile'. Both are correct but visually overlapping — consider deduplicating to avoid double-chip stacking on Step 3.
